purpose: Build two independent TRIO market-residual probability engines from the same frozen inputs: MARKET_PLUS_SEVEN_KING and MARKET_PLUS_OUTSIDER. Keep the probability engine broad and simple so a future World Router can choose or mix them without embedding hand-written race rules here.

MARKET_PLUS_SEVEN_KING.feature_policy: Drop Outsider score/availability and all Outsider-derived p3/delta/alignment features; retain Seven-King consensus, support, dispersion, King probability, market context and King-vs-market disagreement.

MARKET_PLUS_OUTSIDER.feature_policy: Drop Seven-King rank/probability/support/dispersion, King-vs-market gap/dissent, King-derived p3/delta/alignment and race-level King aggregates; retain normalized TRIO market as offset, WIN market context, field size and raw independent Outsider score/availability.

alpha_policy: Select alpha strictly from prior-year calibration; alpha=0 is always allowed.

metrics: bootstrap 95% CI of logloss delta vs market
race-level head-to-head: King residual vs Outsider residual

speed_policy.cpu_split: Each of the two independent engines receives about half of available logical CPUs so both train concurrently without oversubscription.

future_router_contract.output_goal: Produce clean independent engine probabilities and race-level diagnostics that can later be gated/mixed by NORMAL/COLLAPSE/OUTSIDER/BOTH without retraining this experiment.
